mediaView.selectFileHint: Select a PDF or image file from the left panel to start viewing

toolbar.pageInputHint: Enter page number and press Enter to jump

compression.selectFileHint: Select a PDF or image file from the left panel to start compression
compression.revealError: Cannot reveal file in file manager

pdf.downsampleWhenAbove: Conditional DPI (only process images above threshold)

image.aspectRatioLocked: Aspect ratio locked, auto scale proportionally
image.stripMetadataDesc: Remove EXIF, GPS, camera info and other metadata to reduce file size and protect privacy

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust rendering experience and performance parameters. Changes apply in real-time to the main view.
settings.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to defaults?

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for the application interface. Select 'Follow system' to automatically use your system language.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: Switch the interface color theme. Takes effect immediately. Select 'Follow system' to automatically use your system theme setting.
appearance.invertColors: Invert document colors in dark mode
appearance.invertColorsDescription: In dark mode, invert PDF/image colors so white-on-black documents become black-on-white, better for night reading.
appearance.invertColorsDisabled: Dark mode is not currently active.

highRes.title: High-resolution rendering
highRes.description: High-quality pages load after scrolling stops for final viewing and output.
highRes.formatDescription: Format follows settings exactly. No forced downgrade for large pages.
highRes.rawCacheDescription: Raw images consume memory. Recommend 10-15 pages (approx. 30-120 MB).
highRes.dpiCapDescription: Limit high-res rendering DPI to avoid stuttering. Default 144.
highRes.dprCapDescription: Control device pixel ratio scale for output width. Default 1.5.
highRes.maxOutputWidthDescription: Prevent output bitmap from becoming too large in extra-wide containers. Default 1200.
highRes.actualSizeDpiCapDescription: Prevent DPI from becoming too large during high zoom. Default 144.
highRes.zoomRerenderDelayDescription: Delay for triggering high-res re-render after zoom. Default 150 ms.
highRes.hiResRerenderDelayDescription: Default value when no delay specified. Default 300 ms.
highRes.scrollEndDelayDescription: Delay for batch rendering after detecting scroll end. Default 500 ms.

performance.title: Performance control
performance.maxConcurrentRendersDescription: Limit concurrent pages being rendered. Default 4.
performance.highResOverscanDescription: Pages to preload above and below visible area. Default 4.
performance.structureOverscanDescription: Retain DOM structure for pages within ± N of viewport. Beyond that, only render placeholders. Default 10.

zoom.title: Zoom interaction
zoom.maxZoomDescription: Applied to actual size mode for PDFs and images. Default 400%, adjustable 50-800%.
zoom.sensitivityDescription: Control scroll wheel zoom speed. Smaller (0.001) = slower, larger (0.0025) = faster. Default 0.0015.
zoom.sensitivityTip: Tip: This uses exponential zoom. Visual feel is consistent regardless of current zoom level. If zoom feels too fast, decrease; if too slow, increase.

fileOps.title: File operations
fileOps.editSaveDescription: Save strategy after edit actions (e.g., removing pages). Recommend 'save as new file' to reduce risk.

compressionSave.title: Compression save behavior
compressionSave.description: Affects default behavior of 'start compression' on compression page. Can be quickly switched in compression toolbar.

insertDefaults.title: Insert blank page defaults
insertDefaults.customSizeDescription: Only effective when 'Custom size' is selected.

textLayer.title: Text layer
textLayer.enableTextExtractionDescription: Read text info from PDFs, supporting selection, copy, and search. Disabling slightly improves rendering performance.
textLayer.rangeDescription: Text layer renders for center page ± N pages. Larger values allow text selection on distant pages but increase DOM nodes. Default 1.
textLayer.globalOffsetXDescription: Horizontal fine-tune. If selection box is offset right, set negative. Default 0.
textLayer.globalOffsetYDescription: Vertical fine-tune. If selection box is offset down, set positive. Default 0.
textLayer.overlapThresholdDescription: How much overlap to adjust (negative values). Default 0 (adjust only on complete overlap).
textLayer.smallGapThresholdDescription: Below this is considered too small gap. Default 0.5.
textLayer.smallGapSpacingDescription: Adjust to this value for small gap. Default 0.5.
textLayer.tip: Tip: Adjust these values to fix text selection layer positioning. If text is offset left, increase global offset; if some characters overlap, adjust spacing parameters.

export.title: Export settings
export.formatDescription: Determines the exported image file format.
export.jpegQualityDescription: Only effective for JPEG. Higher values = clearer, larger files.

encoding.title: Encoding quality
encoding.jpegQualityDescription: Higher values = clearer, larger files. Recommend 80-85.
encoding.pngCompressionDescription: Balance between speed and file size.

debug.title: Debug & assistance
debug.perfOverlayDescription: Shows current render queue and in-flight count for easy parameter tuning.

update.restartToComplete: Restart the application to complete update

about.author: Author: Yu Feng
about.description: {appName} is a cross-platform PDF/image viewer and editor focused on fast, lightweight desktop experience. Learn about the latest version, support plans, and project licensing here.
about.sponsorDescription: If this project helps you, please buy the author a coffee to sustain long-term development.
about.contactDescription: Follow the GitHub project for update notifications. For suggestions or bug reports, open an issue to help improve {appName}.
